test_title: PYST 73: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In February 2025, the government notified the End‑of‑Life Vehicles (ELV) Rules, effective April 1. Which of the following statements is true with regards to ELV rules?

options.text: Public sold salvaged vehicles are exempt.
Producers must meet EPR targets using scrapping facilities.
All vehicles must be recycled regardless of age.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Producers must meet EPR targets using scrapping facilities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India**, through the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)**, notified the **End-of-Life Vehicles (ELV) Rules** in **February 2025**, which are set to become effective from **April 1, 2025**.
 
• Under these rules, **Producers** (including manufacturers and importers) are required to fulfill **Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)** targets. This means they must ensure that a certain percentage of the vehicles they sell are eventually recycled or scrapped through authorized **Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facilities (RVSF)**. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
